subject: history_social
passage: Caral, in the Supe Valley about 180 kilometers north of Lima, is among the oldest cities in the Americas: its stepped pyramids and sunken circular plazas were built around 2600 BCE, roughly when the first pyramids of Egypt were rising. Its age was not appreciated until systematic excavation began. Since 1994, when the Peruvian archaeologist Ruth Shady started work there, the site ______ a wealth of material, including reed bags used to carry stones, flutes made of bird bones, and knotted cords that may be an early form of record keeping; no pottery has been found, which supports the early date.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The phrase "Since 1994" describes an action that began in the past and continues to the present, and the sentence later uses "has been found." An action stretching from a past starting point up to now takes the present perfect: "has yielded."
explanation.A: Correct. The present perfect "has yielded" fits "Since 1994," which marks a period running from the past up to the present.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The present progressive "is yielding" describes only what is happening now and cannot be used with "Since 1994," which covers the whole period from then until now.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The past perfect "had yielded" would place the action before some other past event, but the sentence gives none; the work continues to the present.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The simple past "yielded" describes a finished action, which does not fit "Since 1994," a period that continues to the present.
